_comment: Default plant profile for document reference and alarm ID extraction.
Copy this file, rename it to your-plant-id_profile.json, and override only the
fields that differ from the defaults.  Pass the path to extract_doc_refs() and
doc_ref_types: each entry defines one document class.
type        - canonical document type (used in DocRef.doc_type)
label       - NER label (doc_ref_<type>) for schema routing
prefixes    - list of prefix strings that appear before the separator
patterns    - list of raw regex strings.  {PREFIX} is replaced with a
non-capturing alternation of all prefixes for this type.
If omitted the generic patterns below are applied.
alarm_patterns: ordered list of pattern entries.
name    - stable identifier (used as source_id in SourceHit)
pattern - raw regex string; full match is the alarm ID
score   - confidence score assigned to this pattern (0-1)
false_positive_filters: global exclusion rules applied after extraction.
min_year / max_year - year values outside this range are rejected
excluded_prefixes   - uppercase prefix strings never treated as doc refs

doc_ref_types.label: doc_ref_cap
doc_ref_types.description: Corrective Action Program entry (alternate CR naming)

doc_ref_types.label: doc_ref_sop
doc_ref_types.description: Procedure reference (OP / MP / SP / EOP / AOP)

doc_ref_types.label: doc_ref_oe
doc_ref_types.description: Operating Experience report (INPO SER / IER / OE)

alarm_patterns.name: short_alarm_id
alarm_patterns.description: Short numeric alarm ID: ALM-1234, ALM-1234A

alarm_patterns.name: annunciator_window
alarm_patterns.description: Annunciator window reference: ANN-A-1, ANNUNC-B-12, WINDOW A-14

alarm_patterns.name: process_alarm_setpoint
alarm_patterns.description: Process alarm with loop tag and setpoint qualifier: e.g. PAS-1234-HI

alarm_patterns.name: kla_point
alarm_patterns.description: KLA/KLR process computer point names common at some sites: RC-0001A
alarm_patterns._note: Lower score — overlaps with equipment tags; context required
